title: Best Poutine in Montreal
description: The best poutine restaurants in Montreal, Quebec — curated from Reddit and local recommendations.

picks.name: La Banquise
picks.address: 994 Rachel St E, Plateau-Mont-Royal, Montreal QC
picks.verdict: Montreal's most famous poutine restaurant, open 24/7 with 70+ varieties.

picks.name: Casse-Normand
picks.verdict: Reddit's consensus choice for best pure poutine in Montreal.

picks.name: Poutineville
picks.address: 1365 Ontario St E, Centre-Sud, Montreal QC
picks.verdict: Build-your-own poutine concept with huge topping variety.

picks.name: Montreal Pool Room
picks.verdict: Historic institution since 1912, best late-night poutine on The Main.

picks.name: Chez Claudette
picks.address: 351 Laurier Ave E, Plateau, Montreal QC
picks.verdict: Neighbourhood institution in the Plateau, excellent classic poutine.

picks.name: Patati Patata
picks.verdict: Tiny counter diner on The Main with legendary poutine and burgers.

picks.name: Chez Tousignant
picks.address: 1292 Beaubien St E, Rosemont, Montreal QC
picks.verdict: Quality poutine in Rosemont with traditional techniques.

picks.name: Greenspot
picks.address: 3041 Notre-Dame St W, Saint-Henri, Montreal QC
picks.verdict: One of Montreal's oldest diners, open since 1941.

picks.name: Ma Poule Mouillée
picks.address: 969 Rachel St E, Plateau, Montreal QC
picks.verdict: Next to La Banquise, often shorter waits with equal quality poutine.

picks.name: Chez Ma Tante
picks.address: 209 Bernard Ave W, Outremont, Montreal QC
picks.verdict: Cozy Outremont diner with traditional Québecois food.

picks.name: Méchant Boeuf Bar Brasserie
picks.address: 124 St-Paul St W, Old Montreal QC
picks.verdict: Best gourmet poutine in Old Montreal with braised beef and house gravy.

picks.name: Mont-Royal Hot-Dog
picks.address: 1101 Mont-Royal Ave E, Plateau, Montreal QC
picks.verdict: No-frills Plateau diner serving solid poutine alongside famous hot dogs.
